notes.title: New Demo Released!
notes.content:
[h2]Demo Version 0.41.1[/h2]
Try out the new demo which will be featured in the Steam Next Festival (Jun 19 - 26). We will also be hosting a Livestream with the Developers so stay tuned!

[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Includes level A-1, A-2, A-3, B-1, and B-3 from the full game.
[*]Controls are now rebindable (as requested by community).
[*]Voice communication implemented (can be enabled or disabled in the options menu).
[*]Hints are displayed during the loading screen.
[*]Minor bug fixes and optimizations.
[*]HOTFIX: Local coop controls were not mapping correctly in some circumstances [i](thanks user sb_prime)[/i]
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[h3]Please join our livestream event![/h3]

notes.title: New Demo Released!
notes.content:
[h2]Demo Version 0.19.0[/h2]
Try out the new demo! Now includes the first five levels and easier access to join a friend's game!

[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]The first five levels of the game can now be accessed in the demo
[*]Includes a friend's list for joining a friend's game in progress
[*]Level difficulty ramps a little bit slower
[*]Saving of progress is now enabled
[*]Fixed a few minor bugs
[*]Minor optimizations
[/list]
